ne.description: रिपोर्ट गरिएको (थाहाखबर र खबर निरन्तर, दुवैले DHM मौसम पूर्वानुमान महाशाखाको कात्तिक ११ बिहानको पूर्वानुमान उद्धृत गरेका): देशमा पश्चिमी वायुको आंशिक प्रभाव छ र बिहीबारदेखि 'अर्नब' चक्रवातको प्रभाव पर्ने। आज दिउँसो कोशी, मधेश, बागमती, गण्डकी र लुम्बिनीमा साधारणतया बदली, कर्णाली र सुदूरपश्चिममा आंशिक बदली; हिमाली भूभागका एक-दुई स्थानमा हल्का वर्षा/हिमपात। आज राति देशभर साधारणतया बदली; कोशी, कर्णाली र सुदूरपश्चिमका हिमाली भूभागका केही/थोरै स्थान र बागमती, गण्डकीका हिमाली भूभागका एक-दुई स्थानमा मध्यम वर्षा/हिमपात; कोशी र बागमतीका पहाड, मधेश र कोशीको तराईका एक-दुई स्थानमा मध्यम वर्षा। कात्तिक १२ देखि १४ को चेतावनीबारे DHM को आधिकारिक ५ दिने बुलेटिन र NDRRMA को उच्च सतर्कता सूचना हेर्नुहोस्।
ne.instruction: पाकेको धान बिहीबार (कात्तिक १२) अगावै भित्र्याउनुहोस्; उच्च पहाडी र हिमाली यात्रा स्थगित गर्नुहोस्; DHM को पछिल्लो पूर्वानुमान हेर्नुहोस् (फोन ११५५)।

ne.description: आधिकारिक (बाढी पूर्वानुमान महाशाखाको विशेष सूचना 'चक्रवात अर्नबको सम्भावित प्रभाव: प्रारम्भिक बाढी-पहिरो तथा अन्य जलविज्ञान जोखिम आंकलन तथा पूर्वसूचना', मिति २०८३ कात्तिक १०, @DHM_FloodEWS मा साँझ ६:१० मा प्रकाशित): कात्तिक ११ देखि १५ सम्म विशेषगरी नारायणी, बागमती, कमला र कोशी जलाधारमा उल्लेख्य वर्षा भई नदीको जलसतह बढ्न सक्ने। कात्तिक ११ (बुधबार): प्रमुख नदीमा जलसतह सामान्य। कात्तिक १२ (बिहीबार): नारायणी, कोशी, बागमती, कमलामा सामान्य वृद्धि, न्यून जोखिम। कात्तिक १३ (शुक्रबार): नारायणी, कोशी र शाखा नदी, बागमती, कमला, तिनाउ तथा आसपासमा मध्यम/भारी वर्षासँगै जलसतह उल्लेख्य बढ्न सक्ने; महाकाली, कर्णाली, पश्चिम राप्ती र बबईमा सामान्य वृद्धि मात्र; मध्यम जोखिम। कात्तिक १४ (शनिबार): प्रमुख नदी उच्चतम विन्दुमा पुगे पनि सतर्कता तह आसपास मात्र, खतरा तह पार गर्ने सम्भावना हालका लागि न्यून; मध्यम जोखिम। कात्तिक १५ (आइतबार): केही स्थानमा हल्का वर्षा, न्यून जोखिम। आकस्मिक बहाव (Flash Flood) जोखिम नक्सा: कात्तिक १३ बिहान ८ बजेदेखि २४ घण्टा उच्च जोखिम: मनाङ, कास्की, लमजुङ, गोरखा, तनहुँ, नवलपरासी पूर्व, चितवन, धादिङ, रसुवा, नुवाकोट, सिन्धुपाल्चोक, दोलखा, मकवानपुर, काठमाडौं, भक्तपुर, ललितपुर, काभ्रेपलाञ्चोक, रामेछाप, सोलुखुम्बु, ओखलढुङ्गा, खोटाङ, भोजपुर, सङ्खुवासभा, ताप्लेजुङ, धनकुटा, सिन्धुली, उदयपुर, पर्सा, बारा, रौतहट, सर्लाही, महोत्तरी, धनुषा, सिराहा, सप्तरी; पूर्व र पश्चिमका थप २१ जिल्लामा मध्यम। कात्तिक १२ र १४ मा पूर्वी र मध्य भागका जिल्लामा मध्यम जोखिम। यो प्रारम्भिक आंकलन हो; वास्तविक वर्षाअनुसार जोखिम बदलिन सक्छ। टोल फ्री ११५५(२) पुनः सुचारु।

en.headline: DHM flood forecasting: because of Cyclone 'Arnab', rivers in the Narayani, Koshi, Bagmati, Kamala and Tinau basins may rise significantly on Kartik 13 (Fri 30 Oct); high flash flood risk in 35 districts
en.description: Official (Flood Forecasting Division special advisory 'Possible impact of Cyclone Arnab: preliminary flood, landslide and other hydrological risk assessment and early warning', dated 2083 Kartik 10, posted on @DHM_FloodEWS at 6:10 PM on 27 Oct): from Kartik 11 to 15 (28 Oct to 1 Nov) significant rain may raise river levels, especially in the Narayani, Bagmati, Kamala and Koshi basins. Kartik 11 (Wed 28 Oct): major rivers normal. Kartik 12 (Thu 29 Oct): slight rise in the Narayani, Koshi, Bagmati and Kamala; low risk. Kartik 13 (Fri 30 Oct): with moderate to heavy rain, levels may rise significantly in the Narayani, Koshi and tributaries, Bagmati, Kamala, Tinau and nearby basins; only a normal rise in the Mahakali, Karnali, West Rapti and Babai; moderate risk. Kartik 14 (Sat 31 Oct): major rivers may peak but reach only around the warning level; for now the chance of crossing the danger level is low; moderate risk. Kartik 15 (Sun 1 Nov): light rain at some places; low risk. Flash flood risk map, 24 hours from 8 AM Kartik 13: high risk in Manang, Kaski, Lamjung, Gorkha, Tanahu, Nawalparasi East, Chitwan, Dhading, Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Sindhupalchok, Dolakha, Makwanpur, Kathmandu, Bhaktapur, Lalitpur, Kavrepalanchok, Ramechhap, Solukhumbu, Okhaldhunga, Khotang, Bhojpur, Sankhuwasabha, Taplejung, Dhankuta, Sindhuli, Udayapur, Parsa, Bara, Rautahat, Sarlahi, Mahottari, Dhanusha, Siraha, Saptari; moderate in 21 more districts to the east and west. Kartik 12 and 14: moderate risk in districts of the east and centre. This is a preliminary assessment; risk may change with actual rainfall. Toll-free 1155(2) restarted.
en.instruction: Avoid travel along river banks, riverside roads, risky river valleys and high mountain areas; take care on essential travel. Do not cross streams or go to river banks. Follow official notices and the local administration. Toll-free 1155(2).

ne.headline: NDRRMA: 'अर्नब' चक्रवात थप शक्तिशाली हुँदै, अति शक्तिशाली बन्न सक्ने; नेपालमा प्रभाव बिहीबार (कात्तिक १२) रातिबाट; २९ देखि ३१ अक्टोबर उच्च सतर्कता
ne.description: अद्यावधिक, आधिकारिक (NDRRMA को अङ्ग्रेजी सूचना 'Request to Remain on High Alert', मिति मंगलबार, २७ अक्टोबर २०२६ / कात्तिक १०, @NDRRMA_Nepal मा बिहान ११:३४ मा प्रकाशित; कात्तिक ९ को नेपाली सूचनाको ठाउँमा): DHM को पोस्ट-मनसुन विशेष बुलेटिनअनुसार बंगालको खाडीमा रहेको 'अर्नब' चक्रवात थप शक्तिशाली हुँदै छ र अति शक्तिशाली (very severe) बन्न सक्छ। यो २८ अक्टोबर (कात्तिक ११) मा भारतमा जमिनमा प्रवेश गर्ने सम्भावना छ र नेपालमा प्रभाव बिहीबार, २९ अक्टोबर (कात्तिक १२) रातिबाट सुरु हुने देखिन्छ। शुक्रबार ३० र शनिबार ३१ अक्टोबर (कात्तिक १३ र १४) कोशी, बागमती, मधेश, गण्डकी र लुम्बिनी बढी प्रभावित हुने; धेरै स्थानमा चट्याङ र हावासहित मध्यमसम्म र थोरै स्थानमा भारी वर्षा। कर्णाली र सुदूरपश्चिमका केही स्थानमा मध्यम र एक-दुई स्थानमा भारी वर्षा सम्भव। उच्च पहाडी र हिमाली क्षेत्रमा भारी हिमपात, हिमआँधी र हिमपहिरोको उच्च जोखिम। २९ देखि ३१ अक्टोबरसम्म उच्च सतर्कतामा रहन अनुरोध।
ne.instruction: पर्यटक उच्च पहाडी र हिमाली क्षेत्रमा नजानुहोस्; गइसकेका भए सुरक्षित ठाउँमा रहनुहोस्। अत्यावश्यक नपरी यात्रा नगर्नुहोस्; सडक, हवाई यातायात र दैनिक जीवन प्रभावित हुन सक्छ। बाढी आउन सक्ने नदी किनार जस्ता जोखिमयुक्त ठाउँमा नबस्नुहोस्। NDRRMA, DHM र सम्बन्धित निकायका पछिल्ला सूचना हेर्नुहोस्। मौसम जानकारी: ११५५; विपद्मा सहायता: १२३४ (NEOC/DEOC), १०० (नेपाल प्रहरी), १११४ (सशस्त्र प्रहरी), पर्यटक प्रहरी ११४४।

en.headline: NDRRMA: Cyclone 'Arnab' gaining strength and likely to become very severe; effects on Nepal from Thursday night, 29 Oct; high alert 29 to 31 Oct
en.description: Update, official (NDRRMA English notice 'Request to Remain on High Alert', dated Tuesday 27 October 2026 / Kartik 10, posted on @NDRRMA_Nepal at 11:34 AM; replaces the Nepali notice of Kartik 9): according to DHM's special post-monsoon bulletin, Cyclone 'Arnab' in the Bay of Bengal is gaining strength and is likely to become very severe. It is likely to make landfall in India on 28 October, and its effects on Nepal are expected to begin on the night of Thursday, 29 October. Koshi, Bagmati, Madhesh, Gandaki and Lumbini are expected to be particularly affected on Friday 30 and Saturday 31 October, with rain of up to moderate intensity with thunder, lightning and wind at many places and heavy rain at a few places. In Karnali and Sudurpaschim, moderate rain with thunder, lightning and wind is likely at some places, with heavy rain possible at one or two. High hill and Himalayan areas face a high risk of heavy snowfall, snowstorms and avalanches. All concerned are requested to remain on high alert from 29 to 31 October.
en.instruction: Tourists should avoid travelling to high hill and Himalayan areas; those already there should stay in safe places. Avoid non-essential travel; road and air transport and daily life may be disrupted. Do not stay in high-risk areas such as riverbanks that may flood. Follow the latest forecasts and warnings from NDRRMA, DHM and other official agencies. Weather information: 1155; disaster help: 1234 (NEOC/DEOC), 100 (Nepal Police), 1114 (Armed Police Force), Tourist Police 1144.

en.headline: DHM: red (take action) for the northern mountains of Gandaki, Bagmati and Koshi on Kartik 13 (Fri 30 Oct); heavy to very heavy rain or snow possible across most of the country from Kartik 12 to 14 (29 to 31 Oct)
en.description: Update, official (DHM Meteorological Forecasting Division 5-day bulletin, issued 2083 Kartik 10 at 8:00 AM, posted on @NMD_Weather at 8:31 AM with an updated warning map at 8:58 AM; replaces the Kartik 9 bulletin): westerly winds are partly affecting the country. The bulletin says there is no weather warning for the next three days, but rain and snow increase from Kartik 12 (Thu) to 14 (Sat). Kartik 10 (Tue 27 Oct): partly cloudy in Koshi, Madhesh and Bagmati, mainly fair elsewhere. Kartik 11 (Wed 28 Oct): generally cloudy, light rain or snow at one or two places in the mountains; at night moderate rain or snow at a few places in the mountains and moderate rain at one or two places in the Koshi and Bagmati hills, Madhesh and the Koshi Terai. Kartik 12 (Thu 29 Oct): moderate rain at many places in Koshi, Madhesh, Bagmati and Gandaki and one or two places in Lumbini, Karnali and Sudurpaschim; at night heavy rain or snow at one or two places in the Koshi, Bagmati and Gandaki hills and mountains and heavy rain at one or two places in the Lumbini hills and Terai (map: northern Gandaki, Bagmati and Koshi orange; Karnali and the rest of the east yellow; Sudurpaschim and most of Lumbini green). Kartik 13 (Fri 30 Oct): mostly cloudy; moderate rain or snow with thunder and lightning at most places in Koshi, Madhesh, Bagmati, Gandaki and Lumbini and many places in Karnali and Sudurpaschim; heavy rain or snow at a few places in Koshi, Madhesh, Bagmati, Gandaki and Lumbini and at one or two places in the Karnali and Sudurpaschim hills and mountains; very heavy rain or snow at one or two places in Koshi, Bagmati, Gandaki and Lumbini (map: the northern mountain areas of Gandaki, Bagmati and Koshi red; Karnali and the rest of Koshi, Bagmati, Gandaki and Madhesh orange; Sudurpaschim, most of Lumbini and the southeastern Koshi Terai yellow). Kartik 14 (Sat 31 Oct): moderate rain or snow with thunder at most places in Koshi, Madhesh, Bagmati, Gandaki and Lumbini and some places in Karnali and Sudurpaschim; heavy at a few places in those five provinces and at one or two places in the Karnali and Sudurpaschim hills and mountains; very heavy at one or two places in Koshi, Madhesh, Bagmati, Gandaki and Lumbini (map: Karnali and the hills and mountains of Gandaki, Bagmati and Koshi orange; Sudurpaschim, Lumbini, Madhesh and the Koshi Terai yellow). From Kartik 12 to 14 DHM asks people to finish bringing in paddy beforehand, take high caution in the high hills and mountains because of heavy snowfall, blizzards and avalanches, and tourists not to go to the high mountains; floods, landslides, road and air transport and daily life may be affected.
en.instruction: Bring in ripe paddy before Kartik 12 (29 Oct); from Kartik 12 to 14 (29 to 31 Oct) avoid high-mountain treks, climbs and non-essential travel, and if already there stay in a safe place; keep away from rivers, streams and landslide-prone slopes. Weather information: DHM phone 1155.

en.description: NDRRMA notice (dated Kartik 9, 2083, Monday 26 Oct): per the post-monsoon special bulletin issued today by the Department of Hydrology and Meteorology, Cyclone 'Arnab' in the Bay of Bengal is strengthening and may become very severe. It may make landfall in India on Kartik 11 (28 Oct), and its effect is expected from Thursday night, Kartik 12 (29 Oct). Especially on Kartik 13 (Friday, 30 Oct) and Kartik 14 (Saturday, 31 Oct), Koshi, Bagmati, Madhesh, Gandaki and Lumbini provinces will be most affected, with moderate rain with thunder and strong wind at many places and heavy rain at a few places. Some places in Karnali and Sudurpaschim may get moderate rain with thunder and wind, and heavy rain at one or two places. High hills and mountains face a high risk of heavy snowfall, blizzards and avalanches.
en.instruction: Finish harvesting and bringing in paddy before Thursday, Kartik 12 (29 Oct). Tourists should not go to high hills and mountains; those already there should stay in a safe place. en.description: Update, official (DHM Meteorological Forecasting Division Special Weather Bulletin for Post-Monsoon - 2, issued 2083 Kartik 9 (Mon 26 Oct) at 4:00 PM, posted on @NMD_Weather at 4:15 PM; replaces the news report of the Kartik 6 special bulletin): Cyclonic Storm 'Arnab' in the Bay of Bengal may strengthen into a Severe and then a Very Severe Cyclonic Storm and make landfall near Yanam, between Andhra Pradesh and Visakhapatnam in India, on Kartik 11 (28 Oct). Heavy snowfall, blizzards and avalanches are a risk in the high hills and mountains. Landslides, floods, road and air transport and daily life may be affected. (The bulletin's combined warning map for Kartik 12 to 14 shows the northern mountains of Karnali, Gandaki, Bagmati and Koshi red, most of the country orange, and western Sudurpaschim and the southeastern Koshi Terai yellow.) For the latest day-by-day map see DHM's 5-day bulletin of Kartik 10 (27 Oct).

en.headline: Bay of Bengal cyclone may affect Nepal's weather from Kartik 11 to 15 (28 Oct to 1 Nov); DHM asks everyone to stay alert
en.description: Reported (Shilapatra and The Kathmandu Post, both citing the post-monsoon special weather bulletin issued by the DHM Meteorological Forecasting Division on the evening of Kartik 6 (Friday, 23 Oct); the exact issue time is not given, so the time of the first news report is used): a low-pressure area formed over the east-central and adjoining southeastern Bay of Bengal at 5:45 AM on Friday. It may strengthen into a cyclonic storm by Kartik 9 (Monday, 26 Oct) and move towards the coast of northern Andhra Pradesh and southern Odisha in India. Because of it, Nepal's weather may be affected from Kartik 11 (Wednesday, 28 Oct) to Kartik 15 (Sunday, 1 Nov). DHM says it is too early to say how much rain Nepal will get or how high the risk will be. It asks everyone to stay alert, as agriculture and tourism could be affected. This is not a colour-coded warning; DHM will issue further updates.
en.instruction: Prepare to protect ripe paddy and crops laid out to dry; before high-mountain treks or long hill journeys from 28 Oct to 1 Nov, check DHM's latest notice.
